DESCRIPTION: Global naming conventions for MAST charge_exchange IDS. MAST's CXRS system (ACT diagnostic) outputs radial profiles directly as 2D signals (major_radius x time) rather than raw per-chord data. The IDS per-channel structure is approximated by treating each spatial position as a separate channel.
_COMMENT_signals: ACT_SS_TEMPERATURE and ACT_SS_VELOCITY are 2D signals (major_radius x time). ACT_SS_MAJOR_RADIUS gives the radial positions and drives the channel count.
